test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B can complete a task in 60 days and 40 days respectively. If C, who can complete the same task alone in 30 days, joins A & B working together after 3 days, then the number of days taken to complete the task will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the task alone = 60 days.

Time taken by B to complete the task alone = 40 days.

Time taken by C to complete the task alone = 30 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/60

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/40

Work done by C in 1 day = 1/30

Total Work done = 1

**Calculation:**

Work done by A and B in 1 day = 1/60 + 1/40

⇒ (1/60) + (1/40) = (2/120) + (3/120) = (5/120) = (1/24)

Work done by A and B in 3 days = 3 × (1/24) = 1/8

Remaining work = 1 - 1/8 = 7/8

Work done by A, B, and C in 1 day = 1/60 + 1/40 + 1/30

⇒ (1/60) + (1/40) + (1/30) = (2/120) + (3/120) + (4/120) = (9/120) = (3/40)

Number of days taken by A, B, and C to complete the remaining work = (7/8) / (3/40)

⇒ (7/8) × (40/3) = (280/24) = (35/3) = 11 (2/3)

**The number of days taken to complete the task with C will be 11(2)/(3) days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

LCM of 60, 40, and 30 = 120 (Total work = 120 units)

Work done per day by A = 120 / 60 = 2 units

Work done per day by B = 120 / 40 = 3 units

Work done per day by C = 120 / 30 = 4 units

Work done by A and B in 3 days = (2 + 3) × 3 = 15 units

Remaining work = 120 - 15 = 105 units

Work done per day by A, B, and C together = 2 + 3 + 4 = 9 units

Time required to complete 105 units = 105 / 9 = 112/3 days

The number of days taken to complete the task with C will be 11(2)/(3) days.
